title: the SECRET://ARGUS/NAME spelling used by C-06 and the help text is accepted

python.note: Spec C-06 and `argus secrets set --help` write references as SECRET://ARGUS/NAME, but argus/secrets.py only accepts the lowercase secret://argus/ prefix (exit 1). URI schemes are case-insensitive (RFC 3986). Operator decision needed: accept the scheme and authority case-insensitively, or change C-06 and the help text to the lowercase form and turn this case around.

rust.note: argus-next implements only --help and --version in P0; commands arrive in later phases (spec section 12)
